_comment: Pinned per-role inputs for dist/<role>/config.yaml (specs/728-D.md D2 shape; specs/728-EF.md D6/D8). Only roles listed here get a generated config.yaml. Portal include = the union of `phases[p]` for p in `active_phases`, mapped through contract-mapping.json and prefixed to served names. A W-step is a data change here (+ the matching Cloudflare flip), never a code change. W1-W3 sets are recorded but NOT rendered until listed in active_phases. Roles without a `portal` key are personal-mcp-only: they render a single-server config.yaml (model + personal-mcp). `gate_wake_kinds` (728-D plan D3; 728-EF D10) renders dist/<role>/scripts/gate.py from generator/data/gate.py.tmpl — one shared logic, per-role wake-kind constants.

personal_mcp.source: personal-mcp src/auth/tool_scopes.json @ cab7aaa (main, byte-identical when read 2026-11-13); live tools/list counts writer 18 / librarian 14 confirmed by the 728-C batch (mint-harvest-2026-11-10.md)

writer.personal_mcp_note: SHADOW withholding (728-D D5 step 3): gmail_send and gmail_delete are withheld — sub=writer loses both server-side in personal-mcp src/auth/tool_scopes.json, and this include list matches (include ⊆ scope is a hard battery rule). This replaces the former group:gmail expansion (10 names) with the explicit 8-name list. Restore is a paired change: re-add gmail_send + gmail_delete here AND restore them to writer's server-side scope in the same change set; never one side alone.
